shared_elements: circular/disc motif (cup marks vs. carved disc)
repeated small vertical strokes forming a comb-like row
justification: Both surfaces bear schematic linear engravings including a human-like figure and small round dots/discs, plus rows of short repeated strokes, but these are generic conventions of incised rock art. A is a single monolithic anthropomorphic figure whose body is covered with concentric discs, bands and emblem-like motifs arranged symmetrically about a central axis, whereas B is a scattered scene of multiple crewed boats with upturned prows accompanied by a spear-bearing figure and cup marks — no shared subject or relationship.
